queries:
WITH j AS (
    SELECT e.ID AS ID, p.SEX AS SEX, e.`aCL IgM` AS igm
    FROM Examination e
    JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID
),
d AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX, igm, igm - (SELECT AVG(igm) FROM j) AS dev
    FROM j
),
s AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX, igm, dev,
           CASE WHEN SEX IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE AVG(dev) OVER (PARTITION BY SEX) END AS sex_avg_dev
    FROM d
)
SELECT ID, SEX, igm AS `aCL IgM`, dev AS deviation, dev - sex_avg_dev AS excess_over_sex_avg_deviation
FROM s
WHERE dev - sex_avg_dev > 0
ORDER BY dev - sex_avg_dev DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH p AS (
    SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, AVG(E.`aCL IgM`) AS igm
    FROM Patient P
    JOIN Examination E ON E.ID = P.ID
    GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX
),
d AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX, igm, igm - (SELECT AVG(igm) FROM p) AS dev
    FROM p
),
s AS (
    SELECT SEX, AVG(dev) AS avg_dev
    FROM d
    GROUP BY SEX
)
SELECT d.ID, d.SEX, d.igm AS `aCL IgM`, d.dev AS deviation, d.dev - s.avg_dev AS excess
FROM d
JOIN s ON d.SEX = s.SEX
WHERE d.dev > s.avg_dev
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH joined AS (
    SELECT e.ID, p.SEX, e.`aCL IgM` AS igm,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.ID ORDER BY e.`aCL IgM` DESC, e.`Examination Date` DESC) AS rn
    FROM Examination e
    JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID
),
entries AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX, igm FROM joined WHERE rn = 1
),
dev AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX, igm, igm - (SELECT AVG(igm) FROM entries) AS deviation
    FROM entries
),
sex_avg AS (
    SELECT SEX, AVG(deviation) AS avg_dev
    FROM dev
    WHERE SEX IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY SEX
)
SELECT d.ID, d.SEX, d.igm AS `aCL IgM`, d.deviation,
       d.deviation - s.avg_dev AS excess
FROM dev d
JOIN sex_avg s ON s.SEX = d.SEX
WHERE d.deviation > s.avg_dev
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX, IgM FROM (
        SELECT e.ID AS ID, p.SEX AS SEX, e.`aCL IgM` AS IgM,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.ID ORDER BY e.`Examination Date` DESC, e.rowid DESC) AS rn
        FROM Examination e
        JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
dev AS (
    SELECT ID, SEX, IgM, IgM - (SELECT AVG(IgM) FROM latest) AS deviation
    FROM latest
),
sexavg AS (
    SELECT d1.ID AS ID, (SELECT AVG(d2.deviation) FROM dev d2 WHERE d2.SEX = d1.SEX) AS avg_dev
    FROM dev d1
)
SELECT d.ID, d.SEX, d.IgM AS `aCL IgM`, d.deviation, d.deviation - s.avg_dev AS excess
FROM dev d
JOIN sexavg s ON s.ID = d.ID
WHERE d.deviation > s.avg_dev
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10;
